production.title: The 17-acre smart nursery is the quality-control center of the company.
production.desc: Agaate's nursery model replaces risky direct sowing with controlled germination, bio-boosted roots, standardized protocols, in-house trials, and traceability before seedlings ever reach a farmer's field.

stats.desc: Seed waste reduction vs direct sowing

dataAdvisory.title: The software opportunity is hidden inside every crop cycle.
dataAdvisory.desc: Every image a farmer sends, every soil report, every fertigation log, every buyer requirement, and every carbon practice can compound into a smarter operating system for Indian vegetable farming.

modules.title: WhatsApp crop tracking
modules.desc: Daily and stage-wise guidance, image issue detection, and direct expert connection.

modules.title: Farm management app
modules.desc: Crop stages, input logs, activity records, alerts, planning tools, and farmer dashboards.

modules.title: Sensors, drones, and AI
modules.desc: Moisture, weather, scouting, crop-health detection, spraying support, and data-driven advisories.

modules.title: Traceable quality
modules.desc: Nursery protocols, batch tracking, partner-backed inputs, and quality checks before field deployment.

dataAdvisory.platformDesc: A repeatable touchpoint that keeps Agaate engaged before, during, and after harvest.
dataAdvisory.carbonDesc: Drip irrigation, reduced tillage, bio-inputs, no residue burning, cover cropping, and better input efficiency can become verified climate income when MRV is handled well.

market.title: Kisan Mall, market linkage, and Agri Park should feel connected, not random.
market.desc: Kisan Mall is the retail gateway. Market linkage is the farmer's revenue gateway. Agri Park is the trust gateway where partners, farmers, and buyers can see the full crop journey on real land.
market.kisanMallTitle: Kisan Mall as a trust and distribution node.
market.kisanMallDesc: Instead of throwing a mall section into the homepage, the landing page now explains why it exists: verified inputs, prescriptions, farmer education, and manufacturer access under one roof.
market.agriParkTitle: India's first integrated Agri Park concept.
market.agriParkDesc: One Agaate farm where seed, nursery, irrigation, nutrition, protection, technology, training, and market partners can be demonstrated on real crops through one walk.

people.title: The people driving the field engine.
people.desc: Our leadership brings together deep expertise across farm operations, agronomy, retail infrastructure, and data science. We are united by a singular vision: to replace guesswork with science and empower every grower to succeed from seed to sale.
